project.name: Lazarus Dev atelier enhancement
project.audience: Indonesian personal portfolio and small business buyers
project.primaryTask: Choose a visual direction and prepare a correctly priced inquiry
project.thesis: A surrealist atelier exhibits seven genuine concept illustrations before the service ledger because visual taste is the studio product.

facts.claim: Seven illustrated design directions and existing forest artwork
Standard 179000, Premium 249000, Business 899000 with ten add-ons
Owner requests stronger visuals and animation guided by Design OS

concepts.name: Surrealist atelier
concepts.readingGrammar: Large editorial invitation, image-led exhibition, quiet aligned pricing
concepts.media: Existing forest framed as a gateway; seven existing concept illustrations
concepts.interaction: Native gallery links and existing process exchange
concepts.tradeoff: Longer gallery before detailed prices; direct price anchors remain

concepts.name: Commission desk
concepts.readingGrammar: Compact sans labels and large numeric totals
concepts.tradeoff: Efficient but undersells the studio visual craft

concepts.name: Field journal
concepts.readingGrammar: Continuous serif essay with marginal annotations

concepts.name: Specimen index
concepts.tradeoff: Adds unnecessary filtering for seven designs

concepts.name: Diptych comparison
concepts.readingGrammar: Parallel headings and aligned table cells
concepts.tradeoff: Task efficient but resembles a price comparison service

concepts.name: Film programme
concepts.readingGrammar: Short scene titles and subtitle rhythm
concepts.tradeoff: Too much cinematic framing for concept illustrations

concepts.name: Material archive
concepts.readingGrammar: Dense catalogue entries with restrained serif labels
concepts.tradeoff: Images too small to demonstrate visual direction

selection.reason: Balances studio visual authorship with immediately accessible prices and an existing working order state.

signature.description: Forest gateway invitation followed by an asymmetric exhibition of the actual seven design concepts
signature.benefit: Visitors see what they can commission before comparing service details
signature.fallback: Ordinary image links and complete price tables without scripts

decisions.choice: Reorder exhibition before detailed package comparison
decisions.benefit: Makes design choice tangible while price anchors remain in opening
decisions.tradeoff: Longer path to detailed prices via scrolling

decisions.choice: Retain S02 and S04; improve bounded hover and entry feedback
decisions.benefit: Motion supports exploration without changing scroll input

avoid.pattern: Neon crypto dashboard and floating glass cards
avoid.reason: Web3 quality means depth and interaction craft, not unrelated financial visual language

avoid.pattern: Continuous particle loops or forced horizontal traversal
avoid.reason: Would compete with pricing and phone reading

comparison.note: Compared with current commercial root and retained forest documentation; atelier changes reading order and media scale. No external client site comparison or independent review claimed.

typography.reason: Invitation display is separated from compact purchase data; larger image-led compositions benefit from a clear typographic anchor. Quiet lacks authorship, ledger overweights price.
typography.fontRights: System Georgia, Times New Roman and system-ui only; no font binaries redistributed.
typography.fallback: Times New Roman then generic serif; OS sans for controls.

voice.pronouns: kami / kamu; legal terms retain original formal wording
voice.rationale: Existing clear Indonesian commercial copy is retained

mobile.readingOrder: Invitation, illustration, gallery, package tables, business configuration, process, terms, inquiry
mobile.illustrationPolicy: Separate artwork below heading at 800; show full image; no illustration overlays over copy
mobile.motionFallback: No tilt on touch; no entry, hover transforms or sticky process under reduced motion
